docket_entries.description: SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE ASSIGNED TO DEPARTMENT 05
TRIAL OFF CALENDAR

#5 JDG WICK. CSR BRENDA FIELDS. CLERK G.VAN HEST. 2:42 PM C/C FOR SETTL CONF. EUGENE VLAHOS, COUNSEL FOR PLTF PRESENT; DEFT DONALD MITCHELL PRESENT IN PRO PER. A DEFAULT TO BE ENTERED AS TO DEFT MARCUS LEE. A STIPULATED JUDGMENT READ INTOTHE RECORD AS FOLLOWS: PLTF TO HAVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES LOCATED AT 1323-B LYON ST,SF. WRIT MAY ISSUE IMMEDIATELY BUT EXECUTION STAYED TILL OCT 13, 1993. EACH SIDE TO BEAR OWN COSTS AND ATTY FEES. IF DEFT TURNS OVER THE KEYS ON OCT 12, 1993 AND LEAVES THE PROPERTY IN GOOD ORDER, PLTF SHALL VACATE THE JUDGMENT AND FILE A DISMISSAL. DEFT CLAIMS HE IS THE SOLE OCCUPANT AND THAT MARCUS LEE HAS VACATED THE PREMISES. PLTF TO PREPARE THE STIPULATION.
